name: verto-vscode
description: Verified, correct-and-faster C++ optimizations in your editor. Every suggestion is proven behavior-identical before it is ever shown.

verto.command.description: Command to run the verto CLI. Use 'verto' if installed, or e.g. 'python3 -m verto.surfaces.cli' to run from a checkout.

verto.args.markdownDescription:
Extra flags passed to `verto optimize`, your choice. Anything from `verto optimize --help` works, e.g.:

```json
["--model", "local", "--min-rung", "1", "--metamorphic", "--fuzz", "5000", "--budget", "$1"]
```

Project policy is best kept in `.verto.toml` (shared with the CLI & CI); use this for editor-specific overrides. The extension always adds `--json`.

verto.compileCommands.description: Convenience for the common `-p` flag: path to compile_commands.json (optional; or just put '-p <path>' in verto.args).
